scope: To identify FOXK2-associated proteins, HEK-293T cells were transfected with pcDNA3.1-FOXK2-Flag using X-tremeGene. Forty-eight hours post transfection, cells were lysed... The lysates were then incubated while rotating at RT for 30 min with anti-Flag M2 Magnetic Beads (Sigma-Aldrich, m8823). Subsequently, beads were washed, and then subjected to on-beads digestion overnight prior to cleanup purification for subsequent analysis using LC/MS-MS.

To identify FOXK2 ubiquitinated lysine residues, HEK-293T cells were transfected with pcDNA3.1-FOXK2-Flag alone or cotransfected with pcDNA3.1-FBXO24-V5. Subsequently, Flag IP was performed, and the beads were subjected to on-beads digestion followed by LC/MS-MS analysis similar to the FOXK2 pull-down method described earlier.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on material affinity-purified using anti-Flag M2 Magnetic Beads (pull-down/IP) to identify FOXK2-associated proteins and ubiquitination sites. While the paper discusses mitochondrial localization and nuclear degradation, the material actually analyzed by LC-MS/MS was the affinity-purified complex.
